text: Marketing will review market research findings and provide guidance before the next meeting (0). ME(FEE016) will evaluate functional requirements from the marketing perspective (1). Email extra details to stakeholders if more information becomes available (2). The meeting also highlighted several problems: the screen is black on the display (3); remote controls are often misplaced with ergonomic/UX concerns and slow learning time (4); RSI risk remains unresolved with budgetary concerns affecting speech recognition and broad-scale marketing (5); and a cost constraint to reduce the number of functions to lower costs with aims to achieve economies of scale for adding features later (6).
